verdict.rationale: Docs confirm automatic 2-way sync with QuickBooks, NetSuite, and other GL systems, plus API access to build org structure (classes/departments), but there is no explicit documentation showing finance-lead-controlled mapping UI for GL account/class/department per transaction, and NetSuite/QuickBooks Online (vs Enterprise) sync depth is unclear. missing for 10: explicit UI/workflow for finance-lead-controlled GL account/class/department mapping rules, confirmation of Xero sync (only QuickBooks Enterprise/NetSuite/Sage/Dynamics named), independent/hands-on verification of mapping accuracy.
